prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Her hand at the shoe slides the yellow card out of the window and drags it flat along the felt under its fingertips, yellow side up, to its place at the far left of the picture, where the last frame shows it. There her thumb slides under the long edge nearest it and lifts it as her wrist turns thumb side up; the card rolls over on its opposite long edge, which stays on the felt, and her thumb comes over onto the blue face. Then her open hand glides back low over the felt, palm down, to the shoe and rests over the next card in the window. The other hand rests on the felt. Only one card moves; its back is yellow and its face is blue.
